text_block_list.text:
I escort Симболи Рудольф to the infirmary
after she
suffers an injury в тренировке.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This is nothing, Trainer—hardly more
than a
bruise. It will heal in no time.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If I were to falter at a scratch like this, I
would be
ashamed to call myself
Emperor.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Why, I could resume training tomorrow if
you
wanted. Haha...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: I was hoping you'd say that!

text_block_list.text:
Ah... I had hoped a little humor would
reassure
you, but it seems to have had
the opposite effect.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф makes to get up, only to
freeze
mid-motion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...It seems I was a little hasty in my
assessment. I
may need time to
recuperate after all.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Then we are of one mind. No hardship is
too
onerous for the Emperor.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I'm always vigilant for opportunities to
put my
ideals into practice.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
My apologies. I see now that putting up
a brave
front is not always the best
answer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: So much for sparing my dignity...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
This is one such time. I will not be
undone by a
minor mishap!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
